name: Eryl
description: Handles semantic questions end-to-end: optionally refines the question against a prior SQL answer, retrieves supporting context from Azure Cognitive Search (vector/semantic search over embedded document chunks), generates a context-grounded answer, and critiques that answer for quality/groundedness — looping back for more context on failure.

sub_agents.name: query_transformer
sub_agents.purpose: Refines the initial question into an updated_question focused on a prior SQL answer's main subject, for a more precise vector search (used in dependent flows).

sub_agents.name: Eryl_agent
sub_agents.purpose: Selector agent: forwards the current (or critic feedback) question to the retriever, and owns the extract_context tool binding.

sub_agents.name: retriever
sub_agents.purpose: Executes extract_context and passes retrieved chunks to llm_answer_maker.

sub_agents.name: llm_answer_maker
sub_agents.purpose: Generates a detailed answer strictly from the retrieved context; states insufficient-context explicitly rather than guessing.

sub_agents.name: critic_agent
sub_agents.purpose: Post-generation evaluator for the semantic flow. Scores the answer against the shared rubric; on FAIL, produces a feedback_query and loops back to Eryl_agent for more context; on PASS, appends the literal phrase 'Happy with the answer' and terminates.

tools.name: extract_context
tools.signature: async extract_context(question: str, vector_weight: float = 0.5, graph_weight: float = 0.5) -> dict
tools.description: Fetches supporting context for `question`. Selector is currently hard-coded to 'vector': embeds the question (Azure OpenAI) and runs a semantic/vector search against Azure Cognitive Search (index configured via AZURE_SEARCH_SERVICE_ENDPOINT / INDEX_NAME). 'graph' and 'hybrid' branches exist for a Localcontext_builder-based graph store but are not selected by default.

handoff_note: user_proxy is owned by the parent orchestrator. Eryl may also be entered directly by Quin's evaluation_agent (which hands off to query_transformer) or by the top-level routing_agent — Eryl only returns agent names via route(); it never imports Quin.

external_resources: Azure OpenAI (GPT-4-class chat deployment + embedding deployment, Embedding_Model)
Azure Cognitive Search (SearchClient over index 'dupont_email_demo', semantic configuration 'my-semantic-config')

statefulness: build_agents() is a factory — call it once per conversation/session to get fresh, independent AssistantAgent instances. No module-level agent singletons are created on import.
